name: Oogami Chie
source:
Chie is the main teacher of the class 2-V "Soleil". She is very serious and wants all her students to devote themselves body and soul to their studies.

She is known as "severe" with bad students. When one of them forgets to do his homework, it gives them 10 times more (and much more complicated) extra work.
